observations.title: addedTurns invariant は JSDoc に明記済みだが runtime 検証は本ステップ外
observations.rationale: addedTurns.reportRetry + addedTurns.outputRepair === followUpAttempts の invariant は port インターフェースの JSDoc に記載されており、request の要件 §1 / §4 が参照する既存契約として正確。implementer が parity contract test でこれを固定することで機械検証される予定。

toolResult.reason: design.md / spec.md / tasks.md written under specrunner/changes/provider-lifecycle-parity-contract/ on branch refactor/provider-lifecycle-parity-contract-efcaecb2. Plan defines a 31-case provider lifecycle parity contract suite under tests/unit/contract/provider-lifecycle/ with provider-neutral turn-script scenarios, per-provider harnesses, shared/provider-specific/absent classification with mandatory reasons, an AgentRunResult capability matrix, universal invariants, and static + execution-ledger coverage ratchets. No production changes planned.

findings.title: T-07: "absent" sentinel の assertion 変換ロジックが未規定
findings.rationale: T-05 で定義した期待値型の `transientRetryAttempts` と `addedTurns` は `数値 | "absent"` の union を持つが、T-07 には "宣言された期待値のみを assert する" とあるだけで、"absent" センチネルを `expect(result.X).toBeUndefined()` へ変換するロジックの仕様が記載されていない。実装者が誤って `expect(result.transientRetryAttempts).toBe("absent")` と実装すると常に失敗するアサーションになり、または "absent" を見てチェックをスキップすると `transient.disabled-omits-attempts-field` ケースのフィールド不在保証が失われる。

findings.title: T-07: `fieldPresence` 期待値の assertion ロジックおよび D4 matrix との役割分担が未規定
findings.rationale: T-05 で期待値型に `fieldPresence?: { [field: string]: "present" | "absent" }` が定義されているが、T-07 にはこの map の各エントリをどう assert するかの仕様がない。また D4 の capability matrix による横断 assert（`absent` field は全 case で `undefined`）との役割分担（matrix = 全 case 横断、fieldPresence = case 固有の spot-check）も明示されていないため、実装者が重複 assert や抜け漏れを起こすリスクがある。

findings.title: TC-042: 台帳検査の test 件数が "台帳検査分" と曖昧
findings.rationale: TC-042 の Then 条件に "実行される test 件数が 62 + 台帳検査分" とあるが、"台帳検査分" の具体的な件数が明示されていない。D9 設計では台帳検査は "実行 (caseId, provider) ペアの完全一致" と "supported field の観測記録" の 2 項目だが、実装によって `it` の数が変わり得るため合格基準が曖昧になる。下限件数（例: 64 件以上）を明記することで検証の厳格さを保てる。

observations.title: Open Question: `metrics.session-rollovers-absent-without-rollover` の shared 分類は能力差を含む
observations.rationale: 設計の Open Questions に明記済み。Claude 側は「rollover 未発生なら absent」、Codex 側は「常に absent」という能力差があるが、scenario（rollover なし）では同じ結果になるため shared 分類としている。case 説明への明記が要求されており、設計の選択として適切に文書化されている。

observations.title: `contextMetrics` の "supported, observed at least once" チェックが scenario 設計に暗黙依存
observations.rationale: `contextMetrics` は Claude SDK が context events を emit したときのみ populate される。`metrics.context-metrics-presence` case の scenario が context window size メトリクスヒントを含まない場合、台帳の "supported field 観測" チェックが失敗し得る。T-02 の metrics ヒント設計（context window サイズのオプション）が利用可能であるため実現可能だが、T-05 の case table 作成時に明示的に設定する必要がある。

findings.title: ratchet-missing-every-area-has-case-check
findings.rationale: ratchet:area only verifies case areas are valid LIFECYCLE_AREA members (cases -> areas). It does not verify the reverse: that every LIFECYCLE_AREA has at least one case (areas -> cases). TC-005 (must) requires 'each declared lifecycle area maps to one or more cases'.

findings.title: dead-resultFileContent-field-in-HarnessBuildOpts
findings.rationale: HarnessBuildOpts.resultFileContent is declared but never passed by the driver or read by either harness. The driver creates result files directly before calling harness.build(), making this field redundant dead surface area.

findings.title: fieldPresence-untyped-string-keys-allow-silent-typos
findings.rationale: ProviderExpectation.fieldPresence is typed as Partial<Record<string, 'present'|'absent'>> instead of Partial<Record<keyof AgentRunResult, ...>>. Field name typos compile silently and produce no assertion.

observations.title: zod-v4-mini-subpath-import
observations.rationale: import { boolean } from 'zod/v4-mini' uses a subpath not seen elsewhere in the project. Functional (typecheck+tests pass) but may be inconsistent with project zod import conventions.

observations.title: agentBranch-supported-classification-may-mislead
observations.rationale: agentBranch is marked supported for both providers but the reason text acknowledges local adapters may leave it undefined, and no test case observes it as present. Classification is contractually correct but could confuse future readers.

observations.title: overall-structure-sound
observations.rationale: Provider-neutral scenarios, separate translation harnesses, nine structural ratchets, frozen ID registry, and acyclic dependency graph (case-ids.ts has zero imports) are clean design choices well-suited for R4b/R4c regression use.

message: code-review iteration 1 completed with verdict: needs-fix

findings.title: Missing execution ledger: 62-pair completeness and supported-field observation unverified
findings.rationale: TC-042 requires ≥64 tests (62 case tests + ≥2 ledger it blocks). TC-024 requires a final it verifying all (caseId×provider) pairs executed. TC-016 requires a final it verifying each matrix-supported field was observed ≥once. Neither ledger check is present. Design D9 items 7-8 mandate both. Without the ledger, a crashing test body silently drops its pair from coverage, and a matrix 'supported' entry can be an empty promise across the entire suite.

findings.title: Universal absent-field check from field matrix not applied in driver
findings.rationale: Design D4 and D7 require the driver to apply the field matrix absent rule universally to every test result regardless of per-case fieldPresence declarations: 'matrix が absent と宣言した field は、その provider の結果で常に undefined であること'. The driver does not import RESULT_FIELD_MATRIX and does not enforce this. Most shared cases (e.g. main-work, report, post-work, output-repair, transient, timeout) declare no fieldPresence entries for Codex, leaving addedTurns, contextMetrics, invocationMetrics, touchedFiles, sessionRollovers unverified for absent status. TC-015 is unimplemented.

findings.title: Missing source-level skip/focus marker ratchet (TC-023, D9 item 5)
findings.rationale: Design D9 item 5 requires the static ratchet to detect it.skip, describe.skip, test.skip, it.todo, and .only in the contract directory source files. No such grep-based check exists among the 9 ratchets. The driver comment says 'test.skip is prohibited by TC-042' but provides no machine enforcement. Additionally, the stale JSDoc at driver line 6 says 'absent provider gets test.skip' — a grep would have caught this inconsistency. TC-023 is unimplemented.

findings.title: Missing SDK containment ratchet for shared contract modules (TC-028, TC-029, D9 item 6)
findings.rationale: Design D9 item 6 requires a ratchet verifying that shared modules (case-ids.ts, scenario.ts, case-table.ts, result-field-matrix.ts, harness/types.ts, driver) do not import from src/adapter/claude-code/, src/adapter/codex/, or provider SDK packages. The containment is satisfied in practice but is not machine-enforced. TC-028 and TC-029 are unimplemented.

findings.title: case-table.ts imports from case-ids.ts, violating D5 and TC-040
findings.rationale: Design D5: 'case-table.ts はこれを import しない（逆方向の依存のみ: ratchet が両方を import して突合）.' TC-040 explicitly tests that this import does not exist. Line 23 is: import type { REQUIRED_CASE_IDS, LIFECYCLE_AREAS } from './case-ids.js'. Even though it is a type-only import with no runtime effect, it creates the coupling the design intentionally avoided. The ratchet already enforces ID matching at runtime, making the compile-time constraint redundant.

findings.title: Stale JSDoc says absent provider gets test.skip — contradicts implementation and TC-042
findings.rationale: Line 6 of the driver's top-of-file JSDoc: '- provider-specific cases: "absent" provider gets test.skip; "supported" runs'. The implementation uses const runTest = test (no skip). A comment 244 lines later explicitly states 'test.skip is prohibited by TC-042'. The JSDoc is a stale artifact from an early design iteration; it contradicts the actual behavior required by TC-012 and D3 and would mislead future maintainers into thinking absent cases are skipped.

findings.title: Codex absent expectations for 3 cases carry no observable assertions
findings.rationale: Design D3: 'absent を明示的な期待値にすれば、provider が将来その機能を得たときに必ず red になり、契約変更が意識的な行為になる.' Three Codex absent expectations have only support:'absent' and reason — no completionReason, errorCode, or fieldPresence assertions: (1) context.rollover-recovers-in-fresh-session — missing completionReason:'error', errorCode:'CODEX_SDK_ERROR', fieldPresence:{sessionRollovers:'absent'}. (2) context.rollover-budget-exhausted — same gaps. (3) report.settle-on-abort-with-captured-report — missing completionReason:'success', toolResult:{ok:true} (Codex completes turn 0 normally since stallAfterReport is ignored).

observations.title: zod/v4-mini import is correct; no issue
observations.rationale: import { boolean } from 'zod/v4-mini' is used to build CONTRACT_REPORT_TOOL's zodSchema. This matches the project's existing zod v4-mini usage pattern and is not a bug.

observations.title: emit cast is unusual but functionally correct
observations.rationale: The emit variable is cast via an elaborate conditional type that always resolves to (..._args: unknown[]) => void. This is equivalent to a direct cast but opaque. Could be simplified to: const emit = (_event: string, _payload: unknown) => {}; but this is style-only and not a defect.

observations.title: UNEXPLAINED prefix ratchet not implemented per D11 letter, but intent is satisfied
observations.rationale: D11 says add a ratchet counting UNEXPLAINED: prefix occurrences. The implemented ratchet 6 instead requires that provider-specific cases with both-supported have reasons ≥40 chars. This is functionally equivalent (zero UNEXPLAINED differences is enforced) but does not check for the literal UNEXPLAINED: prefix convention. Acceptable because no UNEXPLAINED cases were found; the ratchet as written blocks any undocumented difference.

findings.title: 8 tests reported as skipped — TC-042 requires zero skips
findings.rationale: TC-042 acceptance criterion explicitly requires zero skips. The verification output shows 8 skipped. The tasks.md section on actuals acknowledges this discrepancy. Even if the tests technically execute runner.run(), vitest's skip count fails the stated acceptance criterion.

findings.title: emittedEvents observable (D3/D8) not implemented; T-07 task item marked done incorrectly
findings.rationale: D8 states event names are a contract item (not implementation detail). Omitting them means R4b phase-splitting can silently break step:retry or step:rollover emission. The gap is also a tasks.md checklist inaccuracy.

findings.title: transient.budget-exhausted classified 'shared' but expectations have different errorCodes
findings.rationale: The 'shared' classification per D3 guarantees same result. Having divergent errorCode values in a shared case creates a semantic inconsistency that the ratchet cannot detect, and may mislead future contributors about the shared guarantee.

findings.title: TC-031 (zero imports in case-ids.ts) not mechanically enforced by any ratchet test
findings.rationale: Without a dedicated ratchet test scanning for any import statement in case-ids.ts, a future contributor could add a convenience import and all ratchets would pass green, silently breaking the acyclic dependency design.

observations.title: zod/v4-mini import in harness scenario-helper layer
observations.rationale: The helper imports boolean from zod/v4-mini to build CONTRACT_REPORT_TOOL zodSchema. This is project-consistent and in the harness/ directory (not a shared neutral module), so it is not a constraint violation but introduces a Zod dependency in the test helper layer.

observations.title: errorHintPresent observable from D3 also absent from ProviderExpectation
observations.rationale: Design D3 lists errorHintPresent alongside emittedEvents as an observable item. Neither appears in ProviderExpectation nor in assertExpectations. Timeout cases do not assert the error hint from tracker.timeoutHint(). Impact is narrower than emittedEvents but could mask hint regressions in R4b.

observations.title: Ledger pair registration after runner.run() deviates from Design D9
observations.rationale: Design D9 specifies registering the pair at the beginning of each case body (先頭で行い) so assertion failures do not prevent registration. The driver registers after runner.run() returns. Practical risk is low since runners return AgentRunResult and never throw, but it deviates from the stated design.

observations.title: post-work cases share identical scenario objects; duplication intent not documented in code
observations.rationale: post-work.excluded-from-follow-up-attempts and post-work.single-prompt-adds-turn use identical scenario configurations. The design intent (two assertion perspectives on the same scenario) is correct but not commented within the cases, creating a merge risk for future contributors who may try to consolidate them.

findings.title: 8 absent-support tests are skipped instead of executed with absent-behavior assertions
findings.rationale: The verification output shows '62 tests | 8 skipped' for the parity driver. Tasks T-11 confirms '54 passed | 8 skipped (62)' and attributes the 8 skips to the 8 absent-support case+provider combinations. The spec Scenario 'absent support is asserted rather than skipped' requires the case to execute and assert the documented absent behavior. The T-07 acceptance criterion explicitly requires skip 0件. No static skip markers were found (ratchet:no-skip passes), but the 8 tests are not executing; universal invariants and execution ledger coverage (TC-024) may be bypassed for these pairs.

findings.title: UNEXPLAINED ratchet does not scan for UNEXPLAINED: prefix; only checks for missing or short reasons
findings.rationale: The spec Requirement 'The system shall stop instead of normalizing unexplained provider differences' and its scenario 'unexplained difference blocks the suite' require the ratchet to fail when any reason starts with UNEXPLAINED:. Design D11 and Tasks T-08 explicitly require counting reasons starting with UNEXPLAINED: and failing if count > 0. The ratchet:unexplained test (lines 196-218) instead checks that provider-specific cases with both providers supported have reasons ≥ 40 chars. A well-formed UNEXPLAINED: reason (≥ 40 chars) would pass this ratchet and silently survive.

findings.title: Registry ratchet does not cross-check CONTRACT_PROVIDERS against actual src/adapter/ directories containing agent-runner.ts
findings.rationale: The spec Scenario 'adding a local adapter without registering it fails the ratchet' requires the ratchet to scan src/adapter/ for directories containing agent-runner.ts and fail if any are unregistered. Tasks T-08 requires this file system check explicitly. The ratchet:registry test (lines 240-267) only verifies that PROVIDER_HARNESSES keys equal CONTRACT_PROVIDERS; it does not scan the file system.

findings.title: addedTurns arithmetic invariant is per-case opt-in, not a universal invariant applied whenever result.addedTurns is defined
findings.rationale: The spec Scenario 'addedTurns invariant holds wherever addedTurns is present' says 'Given any contract case execution whose result defines addedTurns, When the driver applies the universal invariants, Then addedTurns.reportRetry + addedTurns.outputRepair equals followUpAttempts'. Design D7 lists this as a universal invariant. The driver checks it only when exp.assertAddedTurnsInvariant === true, making it opt-in rather than universal.

findings.title: SDK containment ratchet does not scan src/** for provider SDK imports outside the two allowed adapter directories
findings.rationale: The spec Scenario 'provider SDK imports stay inside the two provider adapter directories' requires a ratchet that lists files in src/ importing @anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk or @openai/codex-sdk and asserts all such files are under src/adapter/claude-code/ or src/adapter/codex/. The ratchet:sdk-containment test (lines 367-406) only checks that the contract suite's own shared modules do not import provider SDKs; it does not scan src/**.
